notes: No California estate, inheritance or gift tax for deaths on or after Jan 1 2005 (the pick-up tax ended when the federal state-death-tax credit was repealed).

item: Maximum ad valorem property tax rate (Prop 13)
source_title: Cal. Const. art. XIII A sec. 1(a)
notes: Voter-approved bonded indebtedness is added on top of the 1% (sec. 1(b)).

item: Maximum annual inflation adjustment of assessed (factored base year) value
source_title: Cal. Const. art. XIII A sec. 2(b)
notes: Lesser of 2% or the California CPI change; value may be reduced in declines (Prop 8).

item: Reassessment to full cash value on change in ownership; date of change for trust property = date of trustor's death
notes: Rev. & Tax. Code sec. 61(h); the transfer date for a revocable-trust inheritance is the transferor's date of death.

value: Transferor's principal residence (family home) or family farm only
notes: Rental, vacation and investment property do NOT qualify and are reassessed to market value on transfer.

item: Prop 19 parent-child exclusion - heir occupancy requirement
value: Move in and claim Homeowners' (or Disabled Veterans') Exemption within 1 year of transfer
notes: No exceptions to the one-year deadline (LTA 2026/026 Q7). Continual-use requirement: if the heir later moves out the exclusion ends and the date-of-death market value (factored) is enrolled.

item: Prop 19 value cap (excluded amount) = factored base year value + adjusted $1 million
notes: Market value above the cap is added to the factored base year value. Adjusted every other Feb 16 by the FHFA California House Price Index.
Late claims get prospective relief only. Homeowners' Exemption (BOE-266) must still be filed within 1 year.

value: Only the unit the transferor occupied as a principal residence can qualify; other units reassessed
notes: Each unit can be a separate principal residence (siblings may each claim a unit the parent occupied).
Worth about $70-80/yr in tax; file BOE-266 by Feb 15 for the full amount.

item: Change in Ownership Statement - Death of Real Property Owner (BOE-502-D)
notes: Filed by the trustee/transferee with the county assessor; penalty of the greater of $100 or 10% of the new tax if not filed within 90 days of an assessor's written request.
Charter cities (e.g., San Francisco) may impose their own higher rates.

item: Transfers by reason of death / gift (including to or from a trust) are exempt from documentary transfer tax
notes: The inheritance itself triggers no transfer tax; a later sale does.

item: Trustee must notify beneficiaries and heirs when a revocable trust becomes irrevocable (death)
notes: Notice starts the 120-day period to contest the trust.

item: California personal income tax brackets (2025 schedules)
notes: 12.3% applies above $742,953 (single) / $1,485,906 (MFJ); 9.3% starts at $72,724 (single) / $145,448 (MFJ). California taxes capital gains as ordinary income (no preferential rate).
Combined top California rate = 13.3% on taxable income above $1 million (e.g., the year a property is sold).

item: Prop 30/55 high-income rates (10.3% - 12.3% brackets) made permanent
source_title: SOS - Qualified Statewide Ballot Measures (Prop 3) and Statewide election results
notes: Unofficial results (Nov 9 2026) show Prop 3 passing with about 60.6% yes; certification by Dec 11 2026. The rates would otherwise have expired after 2030.
